title: WPMS/215/2014 of M/s Maa Amba Associate Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 215 of 2014
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
None for the petitioner.
Present petition was filed on
3.2.2014 with certain defects, as
pointed out by the Registry; vide order
dated 4.2.2014, petitioner was directed
to cure the defects; again, vide order
dated 19.3.2014, petitioner was directed
to cure the defects within a week;
however, this time too, defects were not
cured; vide order dated 31.3.2014, again
three weeksí time was granted to cure
the defects, however, defects have not
be cured as yet.
Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
CLMA No. 668 of 2014 and IA No.
589 of 2014 also stand disposed of
accordingly.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 09.09.2015
Avneet/
